messages:
maya: FYI nightly NetSuite import failed for ~29 invoices. Error looks like rejected negative line amounts after discount rounding.

maya: Log snippet:
```
NetSuite::ValidationError: line amount must be >= 0 (invoice=inv_0Zpqr, line_id=3, amount=-0.01)
```

maya: These invoices include a small promotional discount from the pricing-experiment that leaves a fractional negative cent on a usage line after currency rounding. Stripe charged customers correctly (rounding on their side), but our transform applies discount to the line and then formats cents with two decimals, producing -0.01 in some rare cases.

josh: Oof. So NetSuite is stricter than Stripe about negative zero-ish lines. How many affected?

maya: 29 invoices across multiple customers, mostly low-amount accounts. No double-charges; Stripe went through. NetSuite import aborted for those rows so AR is missing.

kevin: Quick mitigation: change transform to clamp line amounts to min 0.00 after applying discounts and record the rounding delta into an `adjustment` line (positive/negative) with an external_ref linking to invoice_id. That way NS gets valid lines and we preserve audit.

olivia: Approve the clamp + adjustment approach. Finance wants a CSV listing affected invoices and the original rounding delta per invoice so we can review materiality for month-end. Also require the adjustment line to be annotated `promo_rounding_adj` and include experiment id.

ops-jen: @billing-bot please open a ticket and assign to eng with finance review step.

billing-bot: Created FIN-5278: "Clamp negative line amounts from promo rounding -> add adjustment line + audit" assigned to @josh, priority P2, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5278

josh: Plan: (1) add post-transform clamp: if line.amount < 0 => create adj = abs(line.amount) as separate positive adjustment line with code `promo_rounding_adj` and set original line.amount=0.00; include marker `s3=audits/rounding/{invoice_id}.json` and `orig_delta=-0.01` in adj memo. (2) write full original invoice payload to s3://redwood-billing/audit/rounding/{invoice_id}.json (60d lifecycle, finance+eng ACL) (3) unit tests and staging import run. ETA: 6 hours.

maya: Backfill: I paused retries and quarantined the staging CSVs. 29 invoices pending. I'll run a dry-run backfill after PR lands and post `finance_rounding_report_{date}.csv`.

kevin: Also add a validation pre-check to the importer that fails early if line_amount math produces any negative values, and surface a detailed list to FIN ticket so we avoid silent failures.

olivia: Finance asks for the CSV to include invoice_id, customer_id, original_total, delta_amount, experiment_id, suggested_action. We'll review and sign off before mass import.

ops-jen: SRE note: some automatic retry churn occurred when import retried; please keep retries disabled for this class until we confirm idempotent backfill.

josh: Will include idempotency keys and make backfill idempotent. Adding a small marker to adjustment memo: `(round_adj, orig_delta=-0.01, s3=audits/rounding/inv_0Zpqr.json)` as recommended.

maya: Thanks. Please CC finance on FIN-5278 updates. I'll attach current staging CSV to the ticket for debug. :thumbsup:
